notes.title: Update Note 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello, players!

We're rolling out a small update to fix an issue some of you encountered when trying to delete all saved progress in the game. The game did not delete all progress, keeping the islands assembled.

Happy gaming!

Best regards,
Rising Moon Games Team
